༄༅/ /bla ma yang tig gi brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal byin brlabs sprin tshogs bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma yang tig gi brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal byin brlabs sprin tshogs bzhugs so/ /

ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dpal kun tu bzang po'i rang bzhin/ tshad med pa'i thugs rje dang ldan pa/ dpal mgon bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /brtse ba chen pos rjes su gzung du gsol/ gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi 'byung gnas gtso/ /mkhyen rab ye shes rgya mtsho brnyes/ /kun bzang yab yum la phyag 'tshal/ /mi gnas mi dmigs chos sku'i ngang*/ /'od gsal ye shes longs spyod rdzogs/ /yid bzhin rin chen gter mnga' ba'i/ /zhi khro rab 'byams la phyag 'tshal/ /mi 'gyur kun grol ye shes bdag /bde chen chos mchog mi g.yo ba/ /bla med yid bzhin rin chen gter/ /rdo rje 'chang chen la phyag 'tshal/ /'od gsal ye shes sgyu ma'i lha/ / mtshan rdzogs dpe byad dpal 'bar zhing*/ /sku gsum lhun grub rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang chen gyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug 'gro ba'i yab/ /phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /thabs dang shes rab pha rol phyin/ / rnam grol ye shes rgya mtsho brnyes/ /'gro ba'i rtsa lag mchog gyur pa/ /dga' rab rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /bla med grub pa mchog brnyes shing*/ /gsung rab yid bzhin 'byung ba'i mdzod/ /'gro la chos kyi char 'bebs pa/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen la phyag 'tshal/ /mkhyen brtse brtson pa'i nam mkha' la/ /ye shes nyi ma'i 'od gdal bas/ /phyogs bcu'i mun pa sel mdzad pa/ /shṝ sedha la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam dag thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor las/ / phan bde'i ye shes 'od 'phro ba/ /'gro ba'i lam bzang snang mdzad pa/ /dz+nyā na sū tra la phyag 'tshal/ /mkhyen brtse'i 'od stong bla med kyis/ /gsung rab pad+mo kha 'byed cing*/ /'gro ba'i ma rig mun pa sel/ /bi ma mi tra la phyag 'tshal/ / rang byung pad+ma'i sdong po la/ /nyi shar sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes/

/mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal/ /mkhyen brtse'i brtson pa dpag yas shing*/ /sa mchog dkyil 'khor chen po brnyes/ /rnam 'phrul du mas 'gro kun skyong*/ /chos rgyal khri srong la phyag 'tshal/ /ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs rnams kyi/ /gter gyur 'od gsal sgyu ma'i sku/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /ting 'dzin bzang po la phyag 'tshal/ / zab mo'i dam chos mdzod 'dzin cing*/ /bar do'i 'od gsal snying po brnyes/ /brtse chen thabs mkhas thugs rje'i bdag /ldang ma lhun rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam grol brtson pa'i stobs chen gyis/ /zag med ye shes bdud rtsi brnyes/ /'od skur yon tan lhun rdzogs pa'i/ /seng ge dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor zhing*/ /rtag tu zag med 'od gsal dang*/ /mi 'gyur lhun mnyam rdzogs par bzhugs/ /rgyal ba zhang ston la phyag 'tshal/ /sa chen gzungs sprin snying po can/ /rnam grol ye shes mchog rab brnyes/ /'gro ba'i ma rig mun sel ba/ /mkhas pa nyi 'bum la phyag 'tshal/ /bla med tshogs chen rab rdzogs shing*/ /rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa'i gzugs/ /nges don snying po'i don ston pa'i/ /gu ru jo 'ber la phyag 'tshal/ /yang dag sgyu ma'i tshul brnyes shing*/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /rang bzhin sbrul sku'i zhing bgrod pa/ /seng ge rgyab pa la phyag 'tshal/ /chos nyid bden pa rab gzigs shing*/ /ye shes rol pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /dpag med 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /grub chen me long la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam dag 'od gsal snying po'i don/ /rtag tu rang bzhin lhun grub cing*/ /mngon shes gzungs sprin yid bzhin gter/ /ku ma rā dza la phyag 'tshal/ /mi 'gyur rtog pa'i rtsal chen gyis/ /thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas dang*/ /bya bral nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sna tshogs rang grol la phyag 'tshal/ kha bskang ni/

bde legs yon tan thams cad kyi/ /'byung gnas mkhyen brtse'i rgya mtsho che/ /byams dang snying rje'i gter gyur pa/ /bde legs rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba dang bral nas/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen mdzad/ /snying tig zab chos mdzod 'dzin rje/ /bya bral chos rje la phyag 'tshal/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /legs gsung dam chos mdzod 'dzin cing*/ /bkra shis 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i gnas/ /sangs rgyas bkra shis la phyag 'tshal/ /yon tan rin chen dpal 'bar zhing*/ /zab mo'i de nyid legs rtogs nas/ /'gro rnams smin grol 'god mdzad pa'i/ / ghu ṇa shṝ la phyag 'tshal/ /snang srid ye sangs rgyas pa'i don/ /ma lus thugs su chud mdzad cing*/ /zab chos rin chen mdzod 'chang ba'i/ /sangs rgyas rin chen la phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas ma lus thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi gsang ba rin po che/ /snying thig bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal/ /bslab gsum tshul khrims rgyan gyis spras/ /rdo rje gsum gyi rnal 'byor che/ /bla med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /tshul khrims rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal/ /bsod nams tshogs chen lhun rdzogs shing*/ /ye shes rang snang 'od gsal bas/ /srid zhi'i mtha' las rnam par rgyal/ /bsod nams rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /o rgyan slob dpon pad+ma yi/ /rjes bzung shes bya'i don rnams gzigs/ /snying po'i bstan pa 'dzin mdzad pa/ /o rgyan bstan 'dzin la phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal ba'i phrin las ma lus bzung*/ /'gro la phan pa rlabs chen spyod/ /kun gyi bla ma rin po che/ / karma gu ru la phyag 'tshal/ /dri med tshul khrims pad+ma'i mtshor/ /bla med yid bzhin snying po blangs/ /rtag pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod pa'i/ /pad+ma rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal/ /blo gsal pad+ma'i skyed tshal du/ /blo gros 'dab stong sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /blo ldan bung ba tshim byed pa/ /pad+ma blo gros la phyag

'tshal/ /bkra shis phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i dpal/ /smin grol rim gnyis mthar phyin pa/ /dbang phyug yon tan brgyad brnyes pa'i/ /bkra shis dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal/ /skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du/ /zab don bdud rtsi'i ring lugs 'dzin/ /bla med rdo rje snying po'i bdag /tshe ring rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /kun bzang pad+ma'i bstan pa la/ /phyogs ris med par khyab gdal du/ /dad mos gus pas lhur len pa/ /kun bzang khyab gdal la phyag 'tshal/ /bka' drin thugs rje chen po'i mdzod/ /rtsa gsum kun 'dus 'gro ba'i mgon/ /bla med theg pa ma lus 'chang*/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ / yang brgyud tshul gcig la sna tshogs rang grol gyi 'phror / / ngag gi dbang pos rjes su bzung*/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin brnyes/ /byams chen snying rje chen po'i bdag /bya bral chos rje la phyag 'tshal/ /thos bsam rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin/ /yid bzhin 'phags pa'i nor mchog la/ /dbang 'byor don gnyis lhun grub pa'i/ / gzhan phan rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /lung rtogs sho lo ka 'di ngag dbang blo gros kyis chad bsabs bgyis pa lags/ yon tan rgya mtsho'i gter/ /mchog gzigs grub brnyes rdo rje 'dzin/ /mkhyen brtse nus pas 'gro ba 'dul/ /nam mkha' rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /spros pa'i mtshan ma bral ba yi/ /rnam grol zhi ba che la bzhugs/ / sems can kun la brtser ldan pa'i/ /'od gsal klong yangs la phyag 'tshal/ /smin lam dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /'gro ba'i sgrib bzhi yongs sbyangs nas/ /sku bzhi'i dbyings su grol mdzad pa/ /bsod nams rin chen la phyag 'tshal/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i 'od dkar can/ /nyon mongs smag rum 'joms pa'i dgra/ /byang grol ku mud rgyas pa'i gnyen/ /ngag dbang pad+ma la phyag 'tshal/ /theg dgu'i yang rtse rdzogs pa che/ /chos tshul smin grol bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /'dzin mdzad rdo rje 'dzin pa dngos/ /bsod nams dbang po la phyag 'tshal/

/chos kun de nyid thams cad gzigs/ /srid pa'i 'ching gcod shes rab 'bar/ /gang thugs ji bzhin 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /nam mkha' 'jigs med la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam mang thos pa rgya mtsho'i rten/ /rnam dag ting 'dzin zab mo brnyes/ /rnam mkhyen go 'phang mngon gyur pa'i/ /klong rdzogs mtha' bral la phyag 'tshal/ /rdzogs chen nyams bzhes tshad du phebs/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug brtul zhugs can/ khams gsum 'dren pa chos kyi rgyal/ /pad+ma rig 'dzin la phyag 'tshal/ / nyams dang rtogs pa mtha' ru phyin/ /gsang chen bstan pa'i srog shing 'dzin/ /rgyal tshab dam pa thugs rje'i bdag /nam mkha'i mtshan can la phyag 'tshal/ /sdom gsum rnam dag nyes ltung bral/ /chos rnams mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs shing*/ /dbang bskur man ngag srol 'dzin pa/ /pad+ma rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /yongs 'dzin du ma'i zhabs pad brten/ /shes rab gsum gyis nyams su blangs/ /thar lam ston pa'i dad dpon pa/ /dbang rgyal rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal/ /rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso/ /sku bzhi ye shes lnga yi bdag /he ru ka dpal rdo rje 'chang*/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal/ /sku gsum gsang mdzod rgya mtsho che'i/ /yang bcud snying tig yid bzhin nor/ /gtsug 'chang lha dbang rdzogs chen pa/ /bstan 'dzin bzang po la phyag 'tshal/ /gang gi thugs bcud bdud rtsi'i gter/ /blo mchog rin chen bum nang du/ /yongs gtams 'gro kun smin mdzad pa'i/ /kun bzang gzhan phan la phyag 'tshal/ / snying thig brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal kha skong dpa' bo las rab rtsal gyis mdzad pa la sho lo ka rjes ma gnyis gsab bsnan byas pa'o/ / yang na nye brgyud khyad par ba ni kun mkhyen sna tshogs rang grol gyi 'phror/ mkhyen bzang kun gsal lam chen du/ /byams brtse'i 'od stong spro ba'i zer/ /gdul bya'i pad tshal rgyas pa'i gnyen/ /'jigs med gling pa la phyag 'tshal/ /gang gi thugs bcud bdud rtsi'i gter/ /sogs so/

/gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang*/ /dkyil 'khor lhun grub byang chub sems/ /chos dang 'phags pa'i tshogs mchog la/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gzugs mchod rten la sogs pa/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing gi mchog /ma lus ji snyed thams cad la/ /kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor 'das kun gyi byang chub sems/ /bla med 'od gsal snying po ni/ /bde gshegs snying po'i khams mchog la/ /ngo mtshar chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /thar pa'i lam du zhugs rnams dang*/ /dkon mchog sgra dbyangs thos so 'tshal/ /sems can kun gyi rigs kun la'ang*/ /rnam grol slad du phyag 'tshal lo/ /snang srid snod bcud thams cad kun/ /ye nas lhun mnyam sangs rgyas zhing*/ /gdod nas rang bzhin rnam dag pas/ /gnyis med ngang du phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos dang yid las byung ba yi/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin 'di/ /dpag yas nam mkha'i dbyings khyab pas/ /mchod 'os kun la mchod par bgyi/ /rang bzhin mnyam pa'i mchod chen po/ /mkha' mnyam dri ma med pa yis/ /rgyal ba kun la rab mchod cing*/ /dgyes mnyam byang chub mchog chen mchod/ / bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*/ /dge ba kun gyi dngos rnams kyis/ / 'gro kun yongs mchod sems can kun/ /yongs grol ye shes mchod pas mchod/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing rnams su/ / sangs rgyas sems can gnas kyi bar/ /bdag gi yid bzhin mchod sprin gyis/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i mchod sprin shog /lus dang ngag yid sgrib pa kun/ /mchod 'os rnams kyi spyan sngar bshags/ /slan chad rab tu 'gyod sems kyis/ /srog gi slad du'ang mi bgyi'o/ /nyan thos byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi/ /sdom pa gsum dang 'gal gyur pa/ /thams cad rab tu bshags par bgyi/ /lus dang ngag dang yid sgo nas/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje/ /gsang ba gsum dang 'gal gyur pa/ /thams cad ma lus bshags par bgyi/

/shes dang mi spang dang du blang*/ /sgrub dang spyad pa lnga lnga ste/ /rtsa ba yan lag nyams chag kun/ /gnong 'gyod chen pos so sor bshags/ /bdag ni mi mkhas gti mug pas/ /'khor ba ngan song rgyur gyur te/ /thar par bsgribs pa gyur to 'tshal/ /thams cad bshags kyis dag gyur cig /mkha' mnyam yangs pa chen po'i ngang*/ /ma lus rang bzhin rnam dag pa/ /spang blang med pa'i byang chub mchog /chos nyid dbyings su rdzogs gyur cig /rgyal ba kun dang sems can gyis/ /dge ba kun la yi rang zhing*/ /'gro kun bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras byang chub sems/ /'gro ba'i bla ma mchog kun gyis/ /ma lus sems can gnas kyi bar/ /rnam grol mdzad par gsol ba 'debs/ /sku tshe lhun po ltar brtan zhing*/ /ri dbang rgyal po ltar bzhugs nas/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /srid nas zhi bar drang du gsol/ /las dang nyon mongs rgya mtsho 'dir/ /dbang med bying ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ khyed kyi thugs rje'i gru chen gyis/ /yongs su grol bar mdzad du gsol/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung me tshogs kyis/ /yongs su gdungs ba zhi bar mdzod/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis shing rta yi/ /'phang lo 'dra ba gzhig tu gsol/ /tshul min yid byed kyis sprul pa'i/ /spros pa'i bya ba gzhom pa dang*/ don med 'jig rten bya ba las/ / bdag gi yid ni bzlog tu gsol/ /nyin dang mtshan mo dus kun tu/ /sdig sems yid la mi 'gyu zhing*/ /thar pa'i dge la rab zab brtson pas/ /byang chub thob par mdzad du gsol/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub phyir/ /thos bsam sgrub pa lhur len cing*/ /nor bdun yon tan phun tshogs te/ /rtag tu gzhan la phan brtson shog /bdag ni deng nas dus kun tu/ /'gro kun nyer 'tsho'i gzhir gyur te/ /mthong thos dran reg gyur pa kun/ /bla med byang chub thob pa shog /'ga' zhig khro'am dmod kyang rung*/

/de yang byang chub rgyur gyur cig /bdag la brten nas gzhan dag gi /sdig kun zad pa nyid gyur cig /sems can ma lus gnas kyi bar/ /bdag gis brtson pas don byed cing*/ /thams cad 'khor ba las sgrol nas/ /bdag gis byang chub thob par shog /'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i lam/ /snang ba bzhi po mthar phyin nas/ /'pho ba chen po'i lus bzung ste/ / gzhan don mtha' yas spyod par shog /bdag la brten pa'i 'gro ba kun/ / tshe 'di nyid dam bar do 'am/ /phyi ma sbrul sku'i zhing bgrod de/ /thams cad gdod mar grol bar shog /bdag gis brtson pa ma lus kun/ /sems can kun gyi don gyur te/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho rab brgal nas/ /phyam cig sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /snying tig brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal byin rlabs sprin tshogs zhes bya ba theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis sbyar ba rdzogs so// // chos tshul 'di ni dri med 'od zer la/ /slob ma dam pa gzhon nu sangs rgyas kyis/ /bskul ba'i ngor brten pad+ma'i dben gnas mchog /lha ring brag tu legs pa bkod pa yin/ /dge'o/ / thog mar dge ba/ dge'o/ bar du dge ba/ dge'o/ tha mar dge ba/ ces kun la 'dres pa'i don yin no/ /
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (9)bla ma yang tig gi brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal byin brlabs sprin tshogs/ - PAGE 52 -- PAGE 51 -- PAGE 43 -
